items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: When we ain't got nothin' to do, I'll teach you what I know." So he taught me a lot of songs that I had never heard of.

ctx.x: Yeah, a tenor player. Well, actually, I got to know him. And he was working with a quartet out there at some drive-in place where the people would drive in and they'd request numbers. He'd play a number for them, and then, you know, you'd take the hat around and they'd go and throw tips in it and so forth. So he said, "Why don't you come and take up the money?" and so forth. But I really wanted to play. So I'd say, "Well, look, how about letting me play, too?" He said, "Well, that's all right. When we ain't got…

But anyway, we did that for a while, and I got so I could eat by taking up the change, and the guys would chip in and give me something to have so I could go to a restaurant, after we got back in town, and eat, and so forth
